questions.prompt: Which US president authorised the Manhattan Project's use?
questions.fact: He learned the project existed only after becoming president, having been kept out of it as vice president.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the study of soil?
questions.fact: A single teaspoon of healthy soil can contain more microorganisms than there are people on Earth.

questions.prompt: Which sport features an event called the coxless four?
questions.fact: Without a cox, steering is done by one rower using a foot-operated rudder cable.

questions.prompt: Which film features the fictional company Cyberdyne Systems?
questions.fact: The company's name has since been adopted by several real technology firms, which their founders admit was deliberate.

questions.prompt: Which African country's capital is Accra?
questions.fact: The prime meridian passes just east of the city, so it sits almost exactly at zero longitude.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Nineteen Eighty-Four's essay collection, Politics and the English Language?
questions.fact: Its six rules for clear writing end with an instruction to break any of them rather than write something barbarous.

questions.prompt: Which company created the SQLite database engine?
questions.fact: It is in the public domain and is probably the most widely deployed database in the world, shipping inside phones and browsers.
